description: This file contains C++ code for managing JavaScript bridge objects within a WebKit-based browser environment. It includes JavaScript source strings, functions for injecting JavaScript into web pages, and message handling for communication between C++ and JavaScript.

methods.name: CallBridge
methods.description: Handles decoding a message payload, validating UTF-8, and executing a JavaScript script in the WebKit context.

methods.name: OnBridgeQuery
methods.description: Encodes a string payload in base64 and sends a message to the WebKit page.

methods.name: OnCreateBridgeObject
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript object with a function property for message handling.

methods.name: InjectJS
methods.description: Injects JavaScript code into the main frame of a WebKit page and sets up the bridge object.
